Centec Communications.why: Fabless designer of Ethernet switch chips sold into domestic network-equipment makers' supply chains; its 12.8T / 25.6T flagship chips (up to 800G ports) target large-scale data-center and cloud networks, so data-center switch build-out drives its sales.
Centec Communications.evidence: Centec Communications annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-23-2026): Ethernet switch chips were RMB 831,407,405.53 of 2025 revenue; the company offers 12.8Tbps and 25.6Tbps high-end flagship chips for large-scale data-center and cloud-service needs, with a maximum port rate of 800G, and its chips have entered the supply chains of H3C, Ruijie Networks, Maipu Technology and other domestic mainstream network-equipment makers.

players.product: Ethernet switch chips: 12.8T / 25.6T flagship chips (up to 800G ports) for large-scale data centers and cloud, TsingMa.MX 2.4T and GoldenGate 1.2T series, plus switch-chip modules and Ethernet switches

quarterly_data.quarter: Centec Communications annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 R&D (annual report): R&D expense RMB 67,865.27 ten-thousand, up 58.39%, 58.99% of revenue; 418 R&D staff (76.28% of headcount). The high-performance core switch chip project (planned RMB 183,000.00 ten-thousand) had completed R&D of the 2.4T-25.6T series: the 2.4T chip is in volume production and the 12.8T/25.6T products are in market promotion and gradual application at customers. The IPO-funded next-generation network switch chip R&D and volume-production project reached its intended state in June 2025; the router-switch converged network chip project (RMB 35,000.00 ten-thousand), a pre-research project for high-end new chips, was postponed from November 2025 to November 2026 because fast-changing demand lengthened requirement and technology validation.

quarterly_data.quarter: Centec Communications annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Annual report, company strategy (medium to long term): keep investing in high-performance switch chips and raise single-chip 400G/800G port density to support massive node connectivity in data centers; split and evolve mature switch chips around industry-chain and customer needs; extend downward into gigabit and multi-rate access chips for an end-to-end switch-chip offering; build a closer ecosystem with domestic and overseas suppliers, direct customers, end customers and standards bodies. The company (operating review) says it will go all-out to introduce high-end chips by binding closely with leading industry customers, treating the high-end segment as the core engine of future growth, and warns that if market expansion falls short the turnaround to profit may be delayed or losses may widen.
